SELECT
	OriginalDate=CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), S.OriginalDate, 101) AS DATETIME),
	Customer = MAX(CASE WHEN S.CustCode=:al_Custcode THEN S.Customer ELSE NULL END), 
	fbrposfee=SUM(CASE WHEN S.Type = 'S' THEN CASE WHEN S.CustCode=:al_Custcode THEN S.fbrposfee ELSE 0 END ELSE CASE WHEN S.CustCode=:al_Custcode THEN - S.fbrposfee ELSE 0 END END), 
	Sales = SUM(CASE WHEN S.Type = 'S' THEN CASE WHEN S.CustCode=:al_Custcode THEN S.netamount ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END), 
	SReturn = SUM(CASE WHEN S.Type = 'SR' THEN CASE WHEN S.CustCode=:al_Custcode THEN S.netamount ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END), 
	Customer2 = MAX(CASE WHEN S.CustCode=:al_Custcode2 THEN S.Customer ELSE NULL END), 
	Sales2 = SUM(CASE WHEN S.Type = 'S' THEN CASE WHEN S.CustCode=:al_Custcode2 THEN S.netamount ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END), 
	SReturn2 = SUM(CASE WHEN S.Type = 'SR' THEN CASE WHEN S.CustCode=:al_Custcode2 THEN S.netamount ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END)
FROM
	(SELECT  
		Type = 'S',
		CustCode=dbo.saleledger.CustCode,
		Customer = dbo.accounts.name, 
		OriginalDate = dbo.saleledger.originaldate,
		invcode  = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,    
		RefNo = dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo,
		PatientCode=dbo.saleledger.PatientCode,
		regno = dbo.Patient.RegNo,
		patientname = Patient.name,
		Department = (Select dbo.PatientCategory.name From dbo.PatientCategory Where dbo.patient.PatientCatcode = dbo.PatientCategory.PatientCatcode),
		Ward = (Select dbo.Ward.name From dbo.Ward Where dbo.patient.wardcode = dbo.Ward.Wardcode),
		fbrposfee=saleledger.fbrposfee,
		netamount = 
			Round(
				SUM((saledetail.looseqty*(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) + 
					saleledger.misccharges + saleledger.salestax - saleledger.flatdisc - saleledger.fbrposfee, 0) +
			Round(
				SUM( (saledetail.looseqty + saledetail.bonusqty) * saledetail.unitsalestax) + 
				SUM(ROUND( (saledetail.looseqty * 
				  (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
				  (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc)) * saledetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
				ROUND( (SUM((saledetail.looseqty * 
					(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) -
					saleledger.flatdisc) * (saleledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0)
	FROM 
		dbo.saleledger, 
		dbo.saledetail,   
		dbo.accounts, 
		dbo.customer,
		dbo.Patient	
	
	WHERE 
		dbo.saleledger.originaldate Between :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
		dbo.saleledger.custcode  IN (:al_CustCode, :al_CustCode2) AND
		dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode AND
		dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode AND
		dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.saleledger.custcode AND
		dbo.saleledger.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode
	GROUP BY 
		dbo.saleledger.CustCode,
		dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode, 
		dbo.saleledger.originaldate,
		dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
		dbo.saleledger.flatdisc, 
		dbo.saleledger.discperc,
		dbo.saleledger.salestax, 
		dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1,
		dbo.saleledger.patientcode,
		dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo,
		dbo.saleledger.fbrposfee,
		dbo.Patient.RegNo,
		dbo.Patient.Name,
		dbo.patient.PatientCatcode,
		dbo.patient.WardCode,
		dbo.accounts.name
	UNION ALL
	SELECT  
		Type = 'S',
		CustCode=dbo.saleledger.CustCode,
		Customer = dbo.accounts.name, 
		OriginalDate = dbo.saleledger.originaldate,
		invcode  = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,    
		RefNo = dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo,
		PatientCode=dbo.saleledger.PatientCode,
		regno = dbo.Patient.RegNo,
		patientname = Patient.name,
		Department = (Select dbo.PatientCategory.name From dbo.PatientCategory Where dbo.patient.PatientCatcode = dbo.PatientCategory.PatientCatcode),
		Ward = (Select dbo.Ward.name From dbo.Ward Where dbo.patient.wardcode = dbo.Ward.Wardcode),
		fbrposfee=saleledger.fbrposfee,
		netamount = 
			Round(
				SUM((saledetail.looseqty*(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) + 
					saleledger.misccharges + saleledger.salestax - saleledger.flatdisc - saleledger.fbrposfee, 0) +
			Round(
				SUM( (saledetail.looseqty + saledetail.bonusqty) * saledetail.unitsalestax) + 
				SUM(ROUND( (saledetail.looseqty * 
				  (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
				  (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc)) * saledetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
				ROUND( (SUM((saledetail.looseqty * 
					(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) -
					saleledger.flatdisc) * (saleledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0)
	FROM 
		dbo.saleledger, 
		dbo.saleinvdetail saledetail, 
		dbo.accounts, 
		dbo.customer,
		dbo.Patient	
	
	WHERE 
		dbo.saleledger.originaldate Between :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
		dbo.saleledger.custcode  IN (:al_CustCode, :al_CustCode2) AND
		dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode AND
		dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode AND
		dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.saleledger.custcode AND
		dbo.saleledger.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode
	GROUP BY 
		dbo.saleledger.CustCode,
		dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode, 
		dbo.saleledger.originaldate,
		dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
		dbo.saleledger.flatdisc, 
		dbo.saleledger.discperc,
		dbo.saleledger.salestax, 
		dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1,
		dbo.saleledger.patientcode,
		dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo,
		dbo.saleledger.fbrposfee,
		dbo.Patient.RegNo,
		dbo.Patient.Name,
		dbo.patient.PatientCatcode,
		dbo.patient.WardCode,
		dbo.accounts.name
	UNION ALL
	SELECT  
		Type = 'SR',
		CustCode=sr.CustCode,
		Customer = dbo.accounts.name, 
		OriginalDate = sr.originaldate,
		invcode  = sr.srbufferinvcode,
		RefNo = sr.CustRefNo,
		Patientcode=sr.PatientCode,
		regno = dbo.Patient.RegNo,
		patientname = Patient.name,
		Department = (Select dbo.PatientCategory.name From dbo.PatientCategory Where dbo.patient.PatientCatcode = dbo.PatientCategory.PatientCatcode),
		Ward = (Select dbo.Ward.name From dbo.Ward Where dbo.patient.wardcode = dbo.Ward.Wardcode),
		fbrposfee=0.00,
		netamount = 
			Round(
				SUM((sd.looseqty*sd.srprice) *
				(1 - (.01 * sd.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * sr.discperc)) + 
					sr.misccharges + sr.salestax - sr.flatdisc, 0) +
			Round(
				SUM( (sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty) * sd.unitsalestax) + 
				SUM(ROUND( (sd.looseqty * sd.srprice) *
				  (1 - (.01 * sd.discperc)) * sd.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
				ROUND( (SUM((sd.looseqty * 
					(sd.srprice)) *
					(1 - (.01 * sd.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * sr.discperc)) -
					sr.flatdisc) * (sr.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0)
	FROM 
		dbo.srbufferledger sr, 
		dbo.srbufferdetail sd, 
		dbo.accounts, 
		dbo.customer,
		dbo.Patient	
	
	WHERE 
		sr.originaldate Between :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
		sr.custcode  IN (:al_CustCode, :al_CustCode2) AND
		sr.srbufferinvcode = sd.srbufferinvcode AND
		sr.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode AND
		dbo.customer.custcode = sr.custcode AND
		sr.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode
	GROUP BY 
		sr.CustCode,
		sr.srbufferinvcode, 
		sr.originaldate,
		sr.misccharges,   
		sr.flatdisc, 
		sr.discperc,
		sr.salestax, 
		sr.invgstperc1,
		sr.patientcode,
		sr.CustRefNo,
		dbo.Patient.RegNo,
		dbo.Patient.Name,
		dbo.patient.PatientCatcode,
		dbo.patient.WardCode,
		dbo.accounts.name
	UNION ALL
	SELECT  
		Type = 'SR',
		CustCode=dbo.srledger.CustCode,
		Customer = dbo.accounts.name, 
		OriginalDate = dbo.srledger.originaldate,
		invcode  = dbo.srledger.srinvcode,    
		RefNo = dbo.srledger.CustRefNo,
		Patientcode=dbo.srledger.PatientCode,
		regno = dbo.Patient.RegNo,
		patientname = Patient.name,
		Department = (Select dbo.PatientCategory.name From dbo.PatientCategory Where dbo.patient.PatientCatcode = dbo.PatientCategory.PatientCatcode),
		Ward = (Select dbo.Ward.name From dbo.Ward Where dbo.patient.wardcode = dbo.Ward.Wardcode),
		fbrposfee=srledger.fbrposfee,
		netamount = 
			Round(
				SUM((sd.looseqty*sd.srprice) *
				(1 - (.01 * sd.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)) + 
					srledger.misccharges + srledger.salestax - srledger.flatdisc - srledger.fbrposfee, 0) +
			Round(
				SUM( (sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty) * sd.unitsalestax) + 
				SUM(ROUND( (sd.looseqty * sd.srprice) *
				  (1 - (.01 * sd.discperc)) * sd.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
				ROUND( (SUM((sd.looseqty * 
					(sd.srprice)) *
					(1 - (.01 * sd.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)) -
					srledger.flatdisc) * (srledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0)
	FROM 
		dbo.srledger, 
		dbo.srdetail sd, 
		dbo.accounts, 
		dbo.customer,
		dbo.Patient	
	
	WHERE 
		dbo.srledger.originaldate Between :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
		dbo.srledger.custcode  IN (:al_CustCode, :al_CustCode2) AND
		dbo.srledger.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
		dbo.srledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode AND
		dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.srledger.custcode AND
		dbo.srledger.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode
	GROUP BY 
		dbo.srledger.CustCode,
		dbo.srledger.srinvcode, 
		dbo.srledger.originaldate,
		dbo.srledger.misccharges,   
		dbo.srledger.flatdisc, 
		dbo.srledger.discperc,
		dbo.srledger.salestax, 
		dbo.srledger.invgstperc1,
		dbo.srledger.patientcode,
		dbo.srledger.CustRefNo,
		dbo.srledger.fbrposfee,
		dbo.Patient.RegNo,
		dbo.Patient.Name,
		dbo.patient.PatientCatcode,
		dbo.patient.WardCode,
		dbo.accounts.name) AS S
GROUP BY
	CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), S.OriginalDate, 101) AS DATETIME)
